    SELECT receivable_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount
    FROM payment
    WHERE payment_date < '2026-01-01'

         DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m') AS period,
         category,
         SUM(amount) AS expense_amount

  GROUP BY department_id, DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m'), category
)
SELECT d.name AS department_name,
       SUM(b.budget_amount) AS budget_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS expense_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(b.budget_amount), 0) AS budget_execution_rate

LEFT JOIN expense_monthly e ON e.department_id = b.department_id AND e.period = b.period AND e.category = b.category
WHERE b.period = '2025-12'

## 数据口径与查询依据

以下内容由系统根据本次实际执行计划和 SQL 生成，不包含未查询的业务推断。

- **步骤 1口径/聚合要求**：查询 2025Q4 各部门未达标的 KPI。从 kpi_value kv 关联 kpi_target kt，关联条件为 kt.kpi_id = kv.kpi_id 且 kt.department_id = kv.department_id 且 kt.period = kv.period；再关联 kpi_definition kd ON kd.id = kv.kpi_id；关联 org_department d ON d.id = kv.department_id。过滤条件为 kv.period = '2025Q4' 且 kv.actual_value < kt.target_value。返回列：d.name AS department_name、kd.name AS kpi_name、kt.target_value、kv.actual_value、kv.actual_value / NULLIF(kt.target_value, 0) AS kpi_completion_rate。按 kpi_completion_rate 升序排列，可附加 department_name、kpi_name 作为稳定排序。
